scope: Read-only measurement on an isolated native journal/proof copy; no public input, provider call or replay
clock: time.perf_counter in the same Python process for each measured operation
profile: 20,078,692 calls; recursive FieldCodec decoding of 10,147 historical entries dominates repeated evidence reads
verification: Each acquired observation hashes the entire original prefix, decodes appended rows, checks original descriptor/named revision/private role, and rereads the current indexed proof
controls: 15 focused controls passed, including prefix alteration with restored mtime, truncation, inode replacement, symlink, permissions, duplicate/non-user tracked input, malformed append, corrupted proof, new proof generation and closed/wrong-source readers
limits: This measures context verification, not pure managed file I/O, total tool latency or provider queue/capacity. Actual native retained-history tool acceptance is pending. Initial decoding remains once per acquired turn.
